## Evidence level

- [ ] **Proven** — documented by the platform (Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) or a published specification
- [ ] **Likely** — strong consistent evidence from multiple independent studies or wide practitioner consensus, but not officially confirmed
- [ ] **Experimental** — unverified or early. Worth trying, but not established
